<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Agadir Concept — Univers de design
 * Description: ACDU 4.1.0 recovery installer.
 * Version: 4.1.0-recovery2
 */
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

$root  = plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ );
$parts = array();
$local = $root . '.ac-upgrade/chunk-01.txt';

if ( ! is_readable( $local ) ) {
	error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: local chunk 01 missing.' );
	return;
}

$parts[] = trim( (string) file_get_contents( $local ) );

for ( $i = 2; $i <= 5; ++$i ) {
	$name = sprintf( 'chunk-%02d.txt', $i );
	$url  = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agadirconcept2019/agadirconcept/main/.ac-bridge/acdu-home-pack/' . $name . '?cb=1786856709-' . $i;
	$res  = wp_safe_remote_get(
		$url,
		array(
			'timeout'     => 15,
			'redirection' => 0,
			'headers'     => array(
				'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
				'Pragma'        => 'no-cache',
			),
		)
	);
	if ( is_wp_error( $res ) || 200 !== (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $res ) ) {
		error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: remote chunk unavailable: ' . $name );
		return;
	}
	$parts[] = trim( (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body( $res ) );
}

$compressed = base64_decode( implode( '', $parts ), true );
$raw        = false === $compressed ? false : gzdecode( $compressed );
$files      = false === $raw ? null : json_decode( $raw, true );

if ( ! is_array( $files ) ) {
	error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: payload validation failed.' );
	return;
}

$allowed = array(
	'includes/elementor/class-home-widgets.php',
	'includes/class-plugin.php',
	'agadir-concept-design-universes.php',
);

foreach ( $allowed as $relative ) {
	if ( ! isset( $files[ $relative ] ) ) {
		error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: missing payload file: ' . $relative );
		return;
	}
}

foreach ( $allowed as $relative ) {
	if ( 'agadir-concept-design-universes.php' === $relative ) {
		continue;
	}

	$data = base64_decode( (string) $files[ $relative ], true );

	if ( 'includes/elementor/class-home-widgets.php' === $relative && false !== $data ) {
		$data = str_replace( 'private function render_button(', 'protected function render_button(', $data );
		$data = str_replace( 'private function asset(', 'protected function asset(', $data );
	}

	$target = $root . $relative;
	if ( false === $data || ( ! is_dir( dirname( $target ) ) && ! wp_mkdir_p( dirname( $target ) ) ) || false === file_put_contents( $target, $data, LOCK_EX ) ) {
		error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: write failed: ' . $relative );
		return;
	}
}

$main = base64_decode( (string) $files['agadir-concept-design-universes.php'], true );
if ( false === $main || false === file_put_contents( __FILE__, $main, LOCK_EX ) ) {
	error_log( 'ACDU recovery2: main replacement failed.' );
	return;
}

if ( function_exists( 'opcache_invalidate' ) ) {
	@opcache_invalidate( __FILE__, true );
	@opcache_invalidate( $root . 'includes/class-plugin.php', true );
	@opcache_invalidate( $root . 'includes/elementor/class-home-widgets.php', true );
}

define( 'ACDU_VERSION', '4.1.0' );
define( 'ACDU_FILE', __FILE__ );
define( 'ACDU_PATH', $root );
define( 'ACDU_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );

require_once $root . 'includes/class-page-map.php';
require_once $root . 'includes/class-template-data.php';
require_once $root . 'includes/class-template-builder.php';
require_once $root . 'includes/class-provisioner.php';
require_once $root . 'includes/class-plugin.php';
require_once $root . 'includes/class-admin.php';

Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Plugin::instance()->boot();
